title: ServicesDrainageRisk
description: Contract for Brain Migration Slice 4 — Stage 1 services/drainage risk rule. Contract version 1.0.0 (same overall JSON Schema contract convention as the Slices 1-3 schemas; no breaking change, so no contract-version bump). Canonical source of truth: this file, in Project-Check-Brain. Any copy elsewhere (e.g. vendored into the application repository) is a mechanically identical mirror, never independently edited.

ServicesInput.description: The raw Stage 1 'services' answer. The rule is an inequality against the single literal 'No' — every other value (including 'Yes', 'Not sure', an empty string, null, undefined, or an unrecognised/legacy value) triggers the risk. This is the original application's deliberate default (not-yet-confirmed-clear), not an allowlist, and must not be narrowed.

RiskOutput.description: The risk this rule contributes to p.risks1, or null when the rule does not fire (services === 'No' exactly).

text.const: Services or drainage within the footprint may affect the building position, foundations or programme.
